summary: MiroTalk C2C is a self-hosted web application that provides real-time, end-to-end encrypted video calls and screen sharing. It is designed to be embedded directly into existing websites using a standard iframe element.
goodFor: It suits developers who need to integrate basic, encrypted video communication directly into their own web pages without relying on third-party services.
watchOut: The absence of tagged releases suggests that stability may vary, and you should carefully review the AGPL-3.0 licence implications if you plan to modify or integrate the source code.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination properly.
